notes.title: New Upgrades & Game Balance!
notes.content:
Hi! Two new upgrades have been added.

Upgrades

1 - Every 12 seconds throw projectiles spending 10 of energy.
2 - Increase pickup range.

Before there was no good way to deal with hordes of enemies, now you have a chance >:)


Game balance

Now every level up until level 20 adds some upgrades:

- level 2 = +1 Enemy
- level 3 = +1 Star
- level 4 = +1 Enemy
- level 5 = +1 Star
- level 6 = +1 Enemy
- level 7 = +1 Star
- level 8 = +1 Enemy
- level 9 = +1 Star
- level 10 = +25 Maximum energy & +4 Pickup range & +4 Projectiles
- level 12 = +1 Star
- level 14 = +1 Enemy
- level 16 = +1 Enemy
- level 18 = + Star
- level 20 = +25 Maximum energy & +4 Pickup range & +4 Projectiles

[strike]-------------------------------------------------------------------------[/strike]

Before the worm's length was increased per level, now every 4 level up the size is increased.

notes.title: 👾 New Bugs! 👾
notes.content:
That's right! two bugs with unique mechanics have been added!


 yellow bug - shoots energy in your direction.
 pink bug - stands still and spawn little bugs to attack you.

notes.title: 🪱 Hello, Worms! 🪱
notes.content:
Hi! spaceworm is released! 

spaceworm is a casual game each match takes 1 minute longer. ( this is very relative 🥴 )
your goal is eat the maximal of stars, planets and enemies until DIE!


Default & Upgrades

each upgrades increases a value.

enemies
https://i.imgur.com/EdAIbFV.png

- default: 0
- upgrade: add +1 to range.

star & planet
https://i.imgur.com/dXd2Djd.png

- default:
xp_range = 5
quantity = 5
planet_xp_range = xp_range * 4
planet_quantity = quantity / 5

- upgrade:
xp_range = add +1
quantity = add +2

timeout
https://i.imgur.com/BH44uX8.png

- default:
enemies_timeout = 12
food_timeout = 6

- upgrade: add -0.5

energy
https://i.imgur.com/on9Zzp2.png

- default: 20
- upgrade: add +5

energy regeneration
https://i.imgur.com/rFHbAQM.png

- default: 1
- upgrade: add -0.05

life
https://i.imgur.com/R1kYxgL.png

- default: 3
- upgrade: add +1 if life < 3

attack length
https://i.imgur.com/uGNegN3.png

- default: 0
- upgrade: add +1

random
https://i.imgur.com/pGhaXJC.png
